_note: Site rules copied from EP Workspace config/site.json (mrn, timezone, registry_basis_default). Edit here to change them.

soft_rule.message: Unusual MRN prefix (expected 1000000–1209999). Check before adding.

mrn._soft_rule_reason: KAMC MRNs started at 100xxxx and currently reach 120xxxx. The soft rule warns but does not block, so 121xxxx will still be accepted when it appears. Update in Settings.

dashboard._note: Copied from EP Workspace config/site.json dashboard (owner-confirmed 16 Oct 2026, DECISIONS P6-13). Counts only. In this app the clinical counts are per procedure (case = episode with several procedures).

ai._passes: 1 = one request per note with all sections (owner, 16 Oct: stays within a free daily quota, e.g. Gemini free tier 20 requests/day); 2 = pass 1 finds the sections, pass 2 extracts (two requests, fewer tokens each).
ai._providers: fixture (test AI, the 15 sample notes) | anthropic | gemini | openai | off. The Admin switches it in Settings; keys live only in Cloudflare environment variables.
ai._models: Checked against each provider's documentation on 15–16 Oct 2026 (P5). Prices are list prices for the default model (Gemini: until 31 Dec 2026; $1.50/$7.50 from 1 Jan 2027 — update then). On Gemini's free tier nothing is charged; the estimate then overstates. OpenAI price null = tokens counted, cost not estimated. The Admin can change the model in Settings; the estimate keeps the default model's price.
ai._note: MRN, names and phone numbers are removed before a note is sent. Raw notes are never stored or logged. The AI fills the draft only; a person accepts every value.
